title: dryopteris fragrans var. hookeriana
intro: Dryopteris fragrans var. hookeriana, commonly known as Hooker's Wood Fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the Dryopteris genus. It is native to Asia and has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Hooker's Wood Fern include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic properties, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
